messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Gabapentin is a prescription medicine.
Gabapentin is used to treat partial seizures.
Gabapentin is used to treat nerve pain from shingles.
Gabapentin is used to treat restless legs syndrome.
The restless legs syndrome treatment is for the Horizant brand only.
It may also be prescribed off-label for other conditions.
These conditions include diabetic nerve pain, anxiety, and fibromyalgia.
Gabapentin is thought to work by calming overactive nerve signals in the brain and nervous system.
It is an anticonvulsant and nerve pain medication from the drug class gabapentinoids
Gabapentin brand names are Neurontin, Gralise, Horizant, and Relgaabi.
These brand names may not be interchangeable.
Gabapentin is not a federally controlled substance.
Some states classify gabapentin as Schedule V.
Other states require gabapentin prescriptions to be reported to their prescription drug monitoring program.
Prescription drug monitoring programs are used to track prescriptions.
Rules on refills and quantity limits vary by state.
The most common side effects of gabapentin are dizziness.
Triplet: ["Gabapentin", "is a", "prescription medicine"]

The relation 'is a' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject entity is categorized as the type of entity specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has product type': The subject product is categorized as the product type specified by the object entity.
B. 'includes': The subject condition or category includes the specific condition or entity specified by the object entity.
C. 'is defined as': The subject condition or entity is defined by the description specified by the object entity.
D. 'have': The subject group of individuals has or is associated with the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
E. 'located in': The subject entity is situated or based in the location specified by the object entity.
